theme_brief: The Selfish Giant: one English chamber palette (celesta, harp, solo clarinet, strings, soft piano). Four 240 s beds, one per quarter of film-01's scenes as `film --cues-job` spreads them; looped by eav.mix.arrange_cues if narration runs longer. Ducked 19 dB under speech; silence at turns is the edit's job.
